import type {D1DatabaseBinding} from 'turbine-orm/d1';
import {turbine} from './generated/index.js';
declare const binding: D1DatabaseBinding;
const db=turbine(binding);
async function negatives() {
  const selected=await db.records.createMany({data:[],select:{title:true}});
  selected[0]!.id;
  const omitted=await db.records.createMany({data:[],omit:{title:true}});
  omitted[0]!.title;
  const counted=await db.records.createMany({data:[],returning:false});
  counted[0];
  const wrong:number=selected[0]!.title;
  const [built]=await db.$batch([db.records.buildCreateMany({data:[],select:{title:true}})]);
  built[0]!.id;
  const [builtOmit,builtCount]=await db.$batch([db.records.buildCreateMany({data:[],omit:{title:true}}),db.records.buildCreateMany({data:[],returning:false})]);
  builtOmit[0]!.title;
  builtCount[0];
  db.records.findManyStream();
  db.table('records').findManyStreamBatches();
  db.$transaction([]);
  db.$withSession({},async()=>1);
  db.records.createMany({data:[],onConflict:{target:['id'],action:'ignore'}});
  turbine('file:local');
  turbine(binding,{globalFilters:{records:{missing:1}}});
  return wrong;
}
void negatives;
